name: Frank J Hanna Iii
current_role: CEO, Hanna Capital LLC (Atlanta); major shareholder of Atlanticus Holdings (ATLC)
profile: Atlanta entrepreneur, merchant banker and Catholic philanthropist. A former Troutman Sanders corporate attorney, he and brother David devised a methodology for valuing loan portfolios and built firms around it; David is chairman/CEO of Atlanticus, in which Frank holds a large stake. CEO of Hanna Capital since 2006, investing in technology and financial services.
interesting_fact: Through his Solidarity Association he acquired the Hanna Papyrus I (Bodmer Papyri XIV-XV, c.175-225 AD), containing the oldest known text of the Lord's Prayer, and presented it to Pope Benedict XVI in 2007; it is kept in the Vatican Library.
deep_cut_fact: Was a Foundation Fellow and Truman Scholar at the University of Georgia; in 2002 President George W. Bush named him co-chair of the President's Advisory Commission on Educational Excellence for Hispanic Americans. Author of 'What Your Money Means' (2008) and 'A Graduate's Guide to Life' (2017).
notes: Featured in PBS/Acton documentary 'The Call of the Entrepreneur'. Hanna Capital contact page invites inquiries consistent with its investment or philanthropic approach.

name: Li Jianbo
current_role: Chairman, controlling shareholder and actual controller, Luoyang Jalon Micro-Nano New Materials Co. (SSE STAR: 688357)
profile: Founder (1998) and chairman of Luoyang Jalon Micro-Nano New Materials, formerly Luoyang Jianlong Chemical, a maker of molecular-sieve adsorbents and catalysts for industrial gas separation, medical oxygen, energy/petrochemicals and environmental uses. He and Li Xiaohong are the company's actual controllers; in July 2026 he proposed a share buyback for employee incentives.
interesting_fact: Jalon makes molecular-sieve powders, molded and special sieves and activated alumina used in industrial gas separation, medical oxygen, energy/petrochemicals and renewable energy.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding Jalon he spent over a decade (Nov 1987 to Jun 1998) as sales section chief at the Yanshi Donggu water-glass (sodium silicate) factory in Henan.
notes: Company also romanized as Jianlong/Jianlon. For IR contact, consult the company's SSE annual report (board secretary). Molecular sieves for oxygen/gas separation could be an energy-adjacent angle. Company profile lists Li Yicheng as vice chairman/president.

name: Pan Yanqing
current_role: Chairman (and CTO per 2023 report), Shanghai SK Automation Technology / 先惠技术 (SSE STAR: 688155)
profile: Co-founder (2007) and chairman of SK Automation (先惠技术), a Shanghai maker of intelligent automation equipment for automotive production; he and GM Wang Yinglin jointly control the company. Originally serving carmakers such as VW and BMW, it has since 2019 grown on lithium-battery module/PACK lines for CATL and other battery makers.
interesting_fact: SK Automation pivoted from automaker assembly lines into EV battery equipment, winning orders from CATL from 2019; its customers have included BMW Brilliance, SAIC-VW, VW Germany, CATL and Farasis.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding the company he held senior roles at Shanghai Volkswagen and Bosch Rexroth; per Shanghai Securities News he turned down a company-sponsored PhD opportunity at Bosch to start a business making domestic substitutes for imported (mostly German) auto equipment.
notes: Battery/EV manufacturing equipment angle relevant to energy. IR contact available via company's SSE filings (board secretary). Deep-cut PhD detail read via search snippet of the cnstock article (page fetch failed).

name: Gao Weiquan
current_role: Chairman and President, GETO New Materials Group (志特新材, SZSE: 300986)
profile: Chairman since 2015 of GETO New Materials (renamed GETO New Materials Group in 2026), a Jiangxi-based provider of aluminum formwork systems for construction (design, manufacture, sale and rental), listed in 2021. He and Liu Liqin are the actual controllers. GETO is expanding overseas, with subsidiaries in Kazakhstan, Indonesia and the UAE, and into prefabricated/modular products.
interesting_fact: GETO's overseas revenue rose about 39% in 2025 to 722m yuan; it has subsidiaries in Kazakhstan, Indonesia and the UAE.
deep_cut_fact: Born 1972 and formerly named Gao Yuan, he spent 1993-2001 as a clerk at the Guangchang County state tax bureau in Jiangxi, then ran logistics companies (Aohu Logistics) before joining the formwork business; he later earned a Peking University MBA.
notes: IR contact via SZSE filings (board secretary). Company name change announced Aug 2026: https://stock.stockstar.com/notice/SN2026080600000053.shtml

name: Hu Mingming
current_role: Chairman, controlling shareholder and actual controller, Wuxi Delinhai Environmental Technology (德林海, SSE STAR: 688069)
profile: Chairman and controller of Delinhai, a Wuxi company specialising in cyanobacteria (blue-green algae) control and internal-load eutrophication treatment for lakes and reservoirs, listed on the STAR Market in July 2020. He is pushing 'AI + water governance'. In April 2026 he and two other holders agreed to sell 14.97% of the company to Zhu Mingming at 25 yuan/share, without change of control.
interesting_fact: During the 2008 Taihu blue-algae bloom crisis Delinhai pioneered the 'haul ashore, separate algae from water' emergency treatment approach used for large, recurring algal blooms.
deep_cut_fact: In a TMTPost interview he said that with AI empowerment 'lake governance will open a new digital-intelligence era', and framed China's dual-carbon action plan as both a challenge and an opportunity.
notes: He is reportedly a co-inventor on Delinhai algae-harvesting patents (seen only in a search snippet citing https://kmb.cas.cn/tzgg/202305/W020230510346422996328.pdf, unverified). Share transfer to Zhu Mingming pending as of May 2026 reports (https://www.nbd.com.cn/articles/2026-04-30/4377267.html).

name: Xu Yongshou
current_role: Major shareholder (7.10% at end-2025), Guangdong Tapai Group (塔牌集团, SZSE: 002233); no current board role found
profile: Xu Yongshou (徐永寿; listed as 徐勇寿) is a long-time major shareholder of Guangdong Tapai Group, a cement maker headquartered in Jiaoling County, Meizhou. He, Zhong Liehua and Zhang Nengyong formed the company's original controlling concert party until they dissolved it in December 2016, leaving Zhong as controller. He has gradually sold down his stake since 2018.
interesting_fact: Tapai's original controlling shareholders were a three-person concert party (Zhong Liehua, Xu Yongshou, Zhang Nengyong), which was dissolved by agreement on 11 December 2016.
notes: Company IR email is for Tapai (securities affairs rep), not him personally. Held 7.10% (84.66m shares) per 2025 annual report. Very low public profile; no biography found. Alive status not confirmed by a source.

name: Tang Yuanming
current_role: Chairman, controlling shareholder and actual controller, Chongqing Qinan Machinery & Electric (秦安股份, SSE: 603758)
profile: Tang Yuanming (filings: YUANMING TANG, Canadian national) is chairman and controlling shareholder of Chongqing Qinan M&E, a Shanghai-listed automobile parts maker. In November 2025 he agreed to transfer a 5% stake to Rao Yiran as a safeguard for Qinan's planned acquisition of a controlling stake in Anhui Yigao Optoelectronics Technology.
interesting_fact: In Nov 2025 Tang sold 5% of Qinan (21.94m shares) to Rao Yiran, tied to Qinan's plan to buy control of Anhui Yigao Optoelectronics, signalling a move beyond auto parts.
deep_cut_fact: Although he runs a Chongqing manufacturer, Tang is a Canadian citizen and signs SSE filings under the name 'YUANMING TANG'.
notes: Chairman title confirmed in March 2025 results-briefing notice. Board re-election was due July 2026; current chair not re-verified after that.
